stations.name: Long fast straight (1.3 km)
stations.note: Sign-off drive, key 1: tap corrections at 70-100 mph and lift-off on a straight. Pad is at the start of a 1.3 km dead-straight road.

stations.name: Gentle bend (R~230 m, 44 deg)
stations.note: Sign-off drive, key 2: lift-off on a gentle bend. 200 m run-up, then a long sweeper.

stations.name: Tight corner (~86 deg, two-stage)
stations.note: Sign-off drive, key 3: lift mid-corner and the deliberate full-lock slide. 150 m run-up to a sharp ~86 deg turn.

stations.name: Edge berm (150 m to the map edge)
stations.note: Sign-off drive, key 4: drive straight into the terrain-edge berm at speed. The road runs out at the south edge of the map.

stations.name: Busiest town view (34 buildings, 2.2 km of road within 300 m)
stations.note: Sign-off drive, key 6: HUD draws/render reading in the densest built-up spot. Use a low launch speed (0-20 mph).

stations.name: Area-crossing run (1.1 km)
stations.note: Sign-off drive, key 7: flat-out HUD reading while crossing several 256 m terrain chunk boundaries. A different road from key 1.
